watchlist._comment: expandTargets() turns each movie x its theatres x its formats into one target (same shape as the legacy top-level 'fandango' block). 'theatres' is a POOL of metadata; each movie references the subset it cares about by id, because scarcity is per-movie. 'mode': 'seats' tracks seat-pair quality; 'onsale' watches cheaply for tickets to open, then seats. Scan-window knobs are shared by every target.
watchlist._theatres_note: city/lat/lng feed the public site's nearest-first sort (haversine, ~1 km accuracy is plenty). metro groups the Bay Area / LA filter. slug (when known) builds the theatre's Fandango page link.

movies._note: Format-scarce: contested only at 70mm houses. Track all of them for seat quality.
movies.title: The Odyssey

_movies_example._note: Release-scarce: add a tentpole here when it nears on-sale. 'onsale' mode polls cheaply for tickets to open, then flips to seat tracking for the opening window.
_movies_example.title: Avengers: Doomsday

tiers._comment: Auto-derived per auditorium: each row gets a depth fraction (0 front .. 1 back) from its seat coords, and these windows are fractions of that depth + normalized x. Works in any house (9 rows or 20). Tuned so the reference IMAX 70mm auditorium keeps its front-3-excluded / E-F-G-centre shape.

politeness._comment: Good-citizen budget, page-load-shaped: bursts of burstSize requests spaced burstIntervalMs apart, then a jittered burstRestMs pause. maxPerMinute = rolling hard ceiling on top; set offPeakOnly=true to confine scans to offPeakStartHour..offPeakEndHour local time. Server 429/503 + Retry-After are always honored on top of this.
